identity.title: Verify input hash matches decoded source bytes

origin.summary: The 2D plan requires proving that an image hash checked in a local exchange is the same byte generation actually decoded and used for RunRecord provenance when a local user or concurrent writer replaces the file.

state.current_summary: 2D-045 is resolved at the existing TwoDIntegrationExchange owner. The pre-fix race was reproduced: same-length A-to-B replacement decoded B while persisting A provenance, and a truncated replacement published an execution failure Result. The source path now supplies one length/hash-verified byte snapshot to Cv2.ImDecode; immutable input remains identity-stable, replacements are rejected before decode/Result/RunRecord, and focused Debug/Release contracts pass. Recipe snapshot and Mat lifetime owners remain closed, no shared protocol or Original repository changed, and locator late source-path reread, separate recipe/template writers, large-image memory budgeting, privileged writers, power/filesystem failure, hardware, and WPF qualification remain unverified boundaries.

objective.summary: Prove that the source bytes decoded by the 2D integration Run path match the Handoff/RunRecord input hash, or that a replacement/partial write is detected and execution is rejected.
constraints: Reuse TwoDIntegrationExchange.RunAcceptedHandoffAsync as the source owner; do not add a parallel exchange or generic file-lock framework.
Keep PL-0062 recipe byte snapshot and PL-0086 BitmapImageConverter/Mat ownership closed; do not reopen them without a new defect.
Prefer a verified byte snapshot only for the source being decoded; do not copy every artifact or invent a global memory budget.
Use atomic replacement, same-length mutation, and partial/truncated fixture files under D:\OpenVisionLab-TestData\OpenVisionLab_Dev.
Keep explicit ACK/Run/Result and existing Result/lease contracts unchanged except for the source identity guard required by this issue.
Do not modify, stage, commit, or push C:\Git\2D\Original or C:\Git\Shared\OpenVisionLab-Integration-Contracts.
Do not claim protection against power loss, filesystem corruption, hardware, or a malicious privileged writer beyond the tested local replacement boundary.

criteria.text: A deterministic fixture can replace the source after the initial Handoff artifact validation and records whether the current path decodes the original generation, the replacement generation, or rejects before execution; the observed baseline is preserved as evidence.

For an immutable source, the decoded source and persisted RunRecord input identity are the same byte generation. For an atomic replacement, same-length mutation, or partial/truncated write detected before decode, execution is rejected without a Completed Result or a mismatched RunRecord.

The smallest production change, if required, keeps the existing TwoDIntegrationExchange owner, recipe path, explicit ACK/Run/Result contract, and Mat lifetime owner; focused Debug and Release builds and runtime contracts pass.

The issue, reconciliation report, stable feature contract, live handoff, and documentation map record the owner/call path, threat model, fixture, evidence, self-evaluation, and unverified boundaries so 2D-045 is not duplicated.

milestones.summary: Confirm the existing source validation/decode owner and preserve the PL-0062 recipe and PL-0086 Mat boundaries.
Run a deterministic immutable and A-to-B atomic replacement fixture at the validation/decode boundary and preserve the baseline outcome.
If the baseline permits a mismatch, implement the smallest verified-source-byte decode or fail-closed guard without copying unrelated artifacts.
Run focused Debug/Release contracts and record source ownership, evidence, self-evaluation, and remaining boundaries in durable project documents.

context.summary: This is the shortest code-reading route for the hash/decode boundary.

evidence.observation: The current Run path calls ReadHandoff first; ReadHandoff validates artifact length and SHA-256 by opening the path, then RunAcceptedHandoffCoreAsync resolves the same source path and calls Cv2.ImRead(sourcePath) in a later operation. The validator does not return the bytes it hashed, so source validation and decode are separate file generations under replacement.

The documented minimum scope is a local-user/concurrent-writer threat model with a hash-after-validation A-to-B replacement experiment, using verified bytes or a private immutable snapshot only if needed; the acceptance is decoded bytes matching RunRecord input hash or execution being rejected.

PL-0062 already captures recipe XML bytes once for execution and provenance, and PL-0086 already proves independent Mat output/caller ownership. Neither issue proves the exchange source image path remains the same generation between artifact hash validation and Cv2.ImRead.

The pre-fix Debug baseline exited 1 and preserved the race: immutable A completed with MeanValueAvg=32, same-length atomic A-to-B replacement completed with MeanValueAvg=224 while the RunRecord retained A's SHA-256, and a truncated replacement produced a Failed/ExecutionError Result. The report records baselineMismatchObserved=true.

The final Debug VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke build completed with 0 warnings and 0 errors and produced the runner used by the source hash/decode contract. The clean-source-state shim was used only for runtime identity preflight; the Dev worktree remains dirty and no clean-checkout claim is made.

The final Debug runner exited 0. Immutable A completed with source hash equality and MeanValueAvg=32; same-length atomic replacement was rejected with ArtifactHashMismatch before Result or RunRecord publication; truncated replacement was rejected with ArtifactLengthMismatch before Result or RunRecord publication; allPassed=true and baselineMismatchObserved=false.

The final Release VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke build completed with 0 errors and 19 existing nullable warnings and produced the runner used by the source hash/decode contract. The clean-source-state shim was used only for runtime identity preflight; the Dev worktree remains dirty and no clean-checkout claim is made.

The final Release runner exited 0 with the same three passing observations as Debug: immutable source identity and MeanValueAvg=32, ArtifactHashMismatch for same-length replacement without Result/RunRecord, and ArtifactLengthMismatch for truncated replacement without Result/RunRecord.

The durable reconciliation, live handoff, stable feature contract, and documentation map record PL-0103/2D-045 as the single source hash/decode owner, its ReadHandoff -> verified-byte snapshot -> Cv2.ImDecode -> VisionRecipeRunner -> CreateRunRecord call path, the preserved baseline and Debug/Release evidence, the no-Result/no-RunRecord rejection policy, the self-evaluation, the explicit unverified boundaries, and the next candidate set 2D-046/048/051. No duplicate owner or Original-repository mutation was introduced.

The existing --integration-2d regression smoke exited 0 in both Debug and Release after the source decode change. Good/Bad Pass/Ng outcomes, explicit rejected execution blocking, tamper rejection before acknowledgement, metric/coordinate round-trip, and concurrent Run lease protection remained intact.

events.summary: Admit one source-only race fixture around the existing TwoDIntegrationExchange owner. First reproduce the validation/decode generation gap with a deterministic atomic replacement; only then choose a minimal verified-byte decode change if the baseline permits a mismatch.
The reproduced source-generation race is closed with a source-only verified-byte snapshot and fail-closed length/hash checks; focused Debug/Release evidence and durable documentation are complete.
